# Saur fixtures

The mocked answers of the EyeOnSaur tests
([cekage/eyeonsaur-ha](https://github.com/cekage/eyeonsaur-ha), MIT, `tests/mock/`), copied as
they are: `auth.json` (`POST /admin/v2/auth`), `area.json` (`GET /admin/users/v2/website_areas`),
`monthly.json` (`GET .../consumptions/monthly`), `last.json` (`GET .../meter_indexes/last`) and
`delivery.json`. Their values are already fictitious (the authors' "Factice" contracts).
